boxes.name: set_studio_mode
boxes.label: Set studio mode
boxes.help: Switches OBS's studio mode (preview next to program) on or off

boxes.name: set_preview_scene
boxes.label: Set preview scene
boxes.help: Puts a scene into the preview. Only works while studio mode is on

boxes.name: studio_transition
boxes.label: Studio mode transition
boxes.help: Sends the preview live, like the Transition button. Only works while studio mode is on
